characters.name: KOER KUSTI
characters.description: Väike kollakaspruun koer suurte loperdavate kõrvadega, kandmas siniseid triibulisi traksipükse, sõbraliku ja rõõmsameelse ilmega. Armas ja multifilmilik stiil.

characters.name: JÄNES JUSSI
characters.description: Väike valge jänes pikkade kõrvadega, kandmas kollast kapuutsiga vihmamantlit, uudishimulike säravate silmadega ja naeratava näoga. Armas ja multifilmilik stiil.

locations.name: Sügisene park
locations.description: A cheerful autumn park with a soft green grassy hill, colorful yellow and orange leaves on trees in the background, a clear light blue sky with a gentle breeze, and a simple dirt path. Cozy, bright, simple, cute children's illustration style.

pages.scene: Koer Kusti (a small tan dog wearing blue striped overalls) and Jänes Jussi (a small white rabbit in a yellow hooded raincoat) stand side by side on a grassy green hill in an autumn park. Colorful yellow and red leaves fall gently from trees in the background. Kusti and Jussi are smiling brightly under a soft blue sky. Koer Kusti is a small tan dog with big floppy ears in blue striped overalls; Jänes Jussi is a small white rabbit in a yellow hooded raincoat. The grassy hill fills the picture right down to the bottom edge, with no blurred or plain band at the bottom.
